entries.body:
I absolutely love this grant. There have been so many bridge hacks that we need better ways to do cross chain. It has the potential to remove bridge multisigs and honeypot contracts with ability to mint bridged tokens. Plus it's Open Source.
Moreover, a nice bonus not related to security is that it makes cross-chain UX much better too, but considering this is a Security-focused round I find the economic sizing for the security part appropriate.
If it gets adopted by the main TVL protocols as the adoption milestone specifies, I'm very excited to see the new flows that this new primitive will allow.
